task.description: Produce or refresh ADP-06 test specification and test-design evidence for implemented behavior: nullable audit.pipeline_run_id schema compatibility, pipeline_run_id propagation into event metadata for pipeline-driven actions, cross-surface queryability by pipeline_run_id, and backward-compatible null behavior for non-pipeline actions. Ensure full traceability from ADP-06 acceptance criteria to executable tests and identify any missing coverage with severity and requirement linkage.
acceptance_criteria: ADP-06 test spec exists and maps each acceptance criterion to concrete test cases
Spec documents deterministic assertions for audit/event pipeline_run_id propagation and queryability
Spec includes explicit negative/null-behavior assertions for non-pipeline actions
If gaps exist, issues list includes severity and exact missing coverage

result.summary: Produced ADP-06 test specification with deterministic acceptance-traceability to integration evidence for schema compatibility, pipeline correlation propagation, cross-surface queryability, and non-pipeline null compatibility.
